name: list_agents
description: List configured Codex agent profiles.

name: save_agent
description: Create an agent profile. Execution access is explicit.

name: update_agent
description: Update an existing agent, including MCP connection and tool access. Omitted fields retain their current values; access, when supplied, replaces the entire access policy. Changes apply to new runs.

name: delete_agent
description: Delete an unused agent and its saved credentials, portrait and 1Password assignments. Main, agents referenced by tasks (including archived tasks), and agents with active work cannot be deleted. Completed run history is preserved.

name: merge_agents
description: Merge an idle agent into an existing profile, transferring all tasks (including archived), chats (including trash) and run identities atomically. Existing runs retain their engine, model and settings; future task runs use destination defaults. Destination access and live grants must already cover the source. Main can only be the destination. Rejects active/recovering work and plugin delegations. Conversations keep their execution backend and native provenance. Does not change destination permissions or credentials. Requires explicit confirmation.

name: list_mcps
description: List MCP connections, discovered tools, authentication state and saved credential indicators. Secret values are never returned.

name: create_mcp
description: Add an HTTP or command MCP connection. Supports bearer tokens, OAuth and command environment credentials, stored encrypted and never returned. Does not connect or execute commands. For OAuth, open managementUrl and choose Connect in the signed-in browser. Use test_mcp to discover tools, then update_agent to grant access.

name: update_mcp
description: Replace an existing MCP connection configuration; supply its complete non-secret settings. Omit token, clientSecret and env values to preserve saved credentials; removeEnv deletes selected variables. Changing authentication settings clears previous credentials. Invalidates active remote grants. OAuth sign-in is completed from managementUrl in the browser.

name: test_mcp
description: Connect to an MCP server and discover its tools. Command servers execute in the manager environment; only test trusted commands. OAuth requiring user consent must first be connected in the MCPs UI. Returns connection state and safe diagnostics.

name: disconnect_mcp
description: Remove locally stored MCP credentials and invalidate active remote grants while keeping the connection configuration. Provider-side consent is not revoked; running command processes retain their environment until they stop.

name: delete_mcp
description: Delete an MCP connection and its credentials, remove agent selections, and invalidate active remote grants. Running command processes are not stopped.

name: list_projects
description: List registered project workspaces.

name: save_project
description: Register an existing directory inside an allowed workspace root.

name: list_tasks
description: List task instructions and schedules.

name: create_task
description: Create a one-off or scheduled task. This does not execute it immediately.

name: update_task
description: Update an existing task, including pausing its schedule.

name: run_task
description: Queue a task using its agent’s resource access and execution mode. YOLO is the default inside a private agent VM. Unattended runs never prompt for approval. May modify allowed code and external services as instructed.

name: cancel_run
description: Cancel queued or running work. Already completed external effects are preserved.

name: list_runs
description: List recent runs with pagination, without bulky prompts or logs.

name: get_run
description: Get a run and a byte-bounded page of its event log. Continue with nextAfter while hasMore is true, even when a page has fewer than 100 events. A run or event marked truncated remains available in full through read_run_content.

name: read_run_content
description: Read full run metadata or one event as bounded chunks of JSON text, including records marked truncated by get_run. Start at offset 0; concatenate data and pass nextOffset plus sha256 until nextOffset is null. Restart from 0 if the content changes. Offsets count UTF-8 bytes.

eventId.description: Event ID from get_run. Omit to read the full run record.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset. Start at 0, then use nextOffset.

sha256.description: Checksum returned by the first chunk. Required after offset 0 to detect changes.

name: list_skills
description: List global .agents skills or the skills for one registered project.

name: read_skill
description: Read a skill's files with their sizes, modes and revision, or one file's content with path. Text is returned as utf-8, other files as base64.

name: save_skill
description: Create or update SKILL.md with validated frontmatter in .agents/skills.

name: edit_skill_files
description: Apply file changes to a skill in one atomic save: write (utf-8 or base64 content, optional executable), delete, move or mode. Pass the revision from read_skill as base, or null to create the skill. The result needs a valid SKILL.md.

name: list_chats
description: List conversations with pagination, optional agent/project filters and active/trash view. Returns metadata, without messages or marking chats read.

name: get_chat
description: Read conversation metadata and a bounded page of user/queued messages in chronological order. Use chat.runId with get_run for assistant replies and activity. Continue with nextOffset while hasMore. Use read_chat_content for records marked truncated. Private answers are redacted.

name: create_chat
description: Create an empty conversation for an agent and optional project. Send a message separately to start execution.

name: convert_run_to_chat
description: Move a successfully completed mission run into Chats, preserving its session, workspace and history. The original mission schedule remains unchanged. No execution starts until a message is sent. Retrying returns the same chat.

name: send_chat_message
description: Send a message to a conversation. Supply a fresh UUID message.id; reuse it with identical content for safe retries. Queue waits for the current turn; steer joins it. Starts agent work with its configured permissions.

name: edit_chat_message
description: Replace a queued message before delivery. Delivered or sending messages cannot be edited.

name: delete_chat_message
description: Remove a queued message before delivery. Removing a queued answer reopens its question.

name: rename_chat
description: Set a conversation title. Automatic title evaluation may update it after later replies.

name: set_chat_paused
description: Pause or resume the follow-up queue. Pausing lets the current turn finish; resuming permits queued agent work. Use stop_chat to interrupt the current turn.

name: stop_chat
description: Stop the current turn, cancel a scheduled wakeup and pause follow-ups. Queued messages remain available for later resumption.

name: delete_chat
description: Delete a conversation using the existing cleanup lifecycle. Busy chats require confirm: true to stop execution and cancel pending messages/questions. Cleanup may permanently remove history, files and workspace.

name: list_chat_questions
description: List conversation questions with pagination. Returns question fields and status, never saved answers.

name: answer_chat_question
description: Answer a pending question. Supply a fresh UUID answer.id and one answer per field; identical retries are safe. May steer or start agent work.

name: resume_chat
description: Resume a failed or stopped agent execution using its saved session, subject to existing recovery rules. Use set_chat_paused(false) to resume queued follow-ups.

name: restart_chat_session
description: Request a fresh agent session using preserved history and workspace after an unrecoverable session failure. Requires confirm: true and leaves the queue paused.

name: restore_chat
description: Restore a deleted conversation only while the existing retention rules still permit recovery. Does not replay cancelled work.

name: list_chat_artifacts
description: List all published artifact versions in a conversation, with metadata, versions, groups and URLs. Paginated; files remain private unless explicitly shared.

name: read_chat_artifact
description: Download the original bytes of a conversation artifact as bounded base64 chunks, including private files. Start at offset 0, decode each data chunk and append bytes until nextOffset is null. file.digest is the SHA-256 of the complete file.

name: set_chat_artifact_visibility
description: Enable or revoke a public link for one artifact version in any conversation. Only make files public when the user requests sharing. Returns visibility and publicUrl; revocation cannot remove downloaded copies.

name: list_chat_attachments
description: List files attached to a conversation, including files not yet sent. Paginated.

name: read_chat_attachment
description: Download an attachment as bounded base64 chunks. Start at offset 0, decode each data chunk and append bytes until nextOffset is null. file.digest is the SHA-256 of the complete file.

name: upload_chat_attachment
description: Upload a file to a conversation as base64 data (up to 10 MiB decoded, subject to transport request limits). Supply a fresh UUID attachmentId; identical retries are safe. Include its ID in message.attachmentIds to send it.

name: read_chat_content
description: Read complete sanitized chat metadata, user messages and question fields as bounded JSON text chunks, including records marked truncated by get_chat or list_chat_questions. Assistant replies are available through get_run. Start at offset 0; concatenate data and pass nextOffset plus sha256 until nextOffset is null. Restart if content changes. Saved private answers are redacted.

name: list_nodes
description: List execution nodes, their immutable backends (each conversation runs on one backend at a time), budgets, trusted people, agent grants and storage status. Read this before configuring or replacing a node.

name: list_native_callers
description: List current installation owner/member identities eligible for native trust. Membership alone never grants native execution.

name: create_node_enrollment
description: Create a single-use enrollment for a separate node. To switch an existing machine, choose the other backend, install its runtime on that machine, then wait for this exact nodeId in list_nodes. Configure it and agent grants before offering to retire the previous node. Does not move existing conversations or install anything; move them with migrate_chat_backend once the new node is configured.

name: update_node
description: Configure an enrolled node using its current name, tags, limits and admission setting from list_nodes. Native execution requires explicit nativeEnabled and nativeAccounts from list_native_callers, and trusted originating callers. Slots share the configured CPU/RAM/disk budgets. Backend is immutable; enroll another node to change it. Agent access is managed through update_agent.

name: update_node_storage
description: Configure a VM or native node's disk cache, shared memory cache, free-space reserve and synchronization limits. Read its current storage policy from list_nodes and send all six values to preserve unchanged settings. Requires configured private S3 storage and a successful node storage probe, like the owner's Storage dialog.

name: revoke_node
description: Permanently revoke a node identity and its execution grants, preserving files on the machine. After a replacement is configured, releasePlacements returns conversations pinned to or preferring the old node to automatic placement. Ordinary revocation keeps those choices. Conversations retain their execution backend; move them to another node, including one of the other backend, to continue elsewhere. Does not uninstall the runtime or delete its files.

name: get_chat_backend_migration
description: Inspect a conversation's execution backend before moving it to a node of the other backend. Returns its current backend (firecracker VM or native host process), its disk format, authorized destination nodes of the other backend with whether a one-time conversion is needed and whether native authority is already confirmed, plus any pending conversion and its error. Native nodes mount a VM disk in place; only a disk created natively needs conversion before a VM can run it.

name: migrate_chat_backend
description: Move an existing conversation to an authorized node of the other execution backend, keeping the same chat, history and files. A VM disk moves to a native node without copying: execution pauses, the same files are mounted in place and the conversation resumes there; system packages installed in the VM and running processes do not follow. Moving back to a VM is the same. A disk created on a native node is converted once before a VM can run it: that stops the active turn, keeps the original until the converted copy is restored, and the next message starts a fresh engine session. Moving to a native node records the caller as the conversation's native authority and requires that node to trust them. Returns immediately; poll get_chat_backend_migration for conversions. Requires explicit confirmation and installation management access.

backend.description: Optional: the backend of the destination node, checked when given.

name: list_plugins
description: List installed plugins, their manifests and configured instances, without credentials.

name: manage_plugin
description: Configure plugin instances and start/poll OAuth or device sign-in without exposing tokens. setup returns the callback URL, owner management URL and the ordered setup steps the owner follows. save takes complete instance data (name, enabled, settings, secrets?, credentialFlow?); instanceId selects an existing account. For signin, form and save, data.sharedFrom names an instance of the same plugin whose shared setup (such as its OAuth client and secret) is reused inside the installation; it requires your grant on that instance. OAuth consent is completed by the owner in their browser. Agent grants stay in the owner agent editor. File-backed plugin commands use the run-specific plugin tool.
